registerNotes.intimate: तू is for very close friends and family. Practise this one with आप and तुम.

l1.text: कौन-सा {thing} बेहतर है, ये वाला या वो वाला?
l1.rom: kaun-saa {thing} behtar hai, ye vaalaa yaa vo vaalaa?

l2.text: ये वाला सस्ता है, पर वो वाला तेज़ है।
l2.rom: ye vaalaa sastaa hai, par vo vaalaa tez hai.

l3.text: मुझे सस्ता वाला ज़्यादा पसंद है।
l3.rom: mujhe sastaa vaalaa zyaadaa pasand hai.

l5.text: क्योंकि मुझे तेज़ वाला नहीं चाहिए।
l5.rom: kyonki mujhe tez vaalaa naheen chaahie.

prefer-cheaper.text: मुझे सस्ता वाला ज़्यादा पसंद है
prefer-cheaper.rom: mujhe sastaa vaalaa zyaadaa pasand hai
prefer-cheaper.literal: to-me cheap one more liked is

notes: Hindi compares with से and the plain adjective: ये उससे सस्ता है ("this, from that, is cheap") means this is cheaper than that.
In the dialogue, "cheaper" is just सस्ता: with two things, the context does the comparing. ज़्यादा adds "more".
वाला after a word means "the one": ये वाला (this one), सस्ता वाला (the cheap one). For a feminine thing it is वाली.
बेहतर (better) is one of the few adjectives with its own comparative form.
